craft_notes: P03 REFRAIN (svarūpastho 'smi saṃsthitaḥ — the first-person seal; flagged at T1, carried un-smoothed; NO invented refrain — this IS the refrain). Sthāyin: seal-joy (I stand). Sanskrit first: three gains + first-person seal → L4 keeps gains line 1, seal line 2 verbatim-music. Rows: row 1 (form-last — saṃsthitaḥ closes as form closes). Rupture: comma after gone — gains done, self stated. Close: end-weight on own form (the seal word). Minimal pass: 'spent and gone' for nirvṛttā (ceased sung); seal line untouched. Read aloud: won, ended, broke — I STAND. Rejected: 'myself' for aham — killed: I kept (first-person seal must stay first-person); 'abide' for saṃsthita — kept? L4 'stand firm' — standing kept.

lines: My form's rest won, my sorrows spent and gone,
grasper and grasped broke — I stand firm in my own form.
l4.sanskrit_cite: labdhā svarūpaviśrāntir nirvṛttā kleśasantatiḥ / grāhyagrāhakatā bhagnā svarūpastho' smi saṃsthitaḥ

reads_against.argmap: Rest gained, suffering ceased, grasper broken — I stand firm, abiding in own form.
c1_essence: Rest gained, sorrows ceased, grasper broken: I stand firm in own form.
